description: Multi-cloud architecture, Kubernetes, SRE observability, platform engineering, and edge systems.

kubernetes_cloud_native.name: Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Platforms
kubernetes_cloud_native.description: Container orchestration, Helm charts, service meshes (Istio/Cilium), and K8s operators.

sre_observability.name: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) & Observability
sre_observability.description: OpenTelemetry metrics/logs/traces, Prometheus alerting, chaos engineering, and SLO/error budgets.

platform_iac.name: Platform Engineering & Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
platform_iac.description: Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Crossplane, and internal developer platforms (Backstage).

edge_computing.name: Edge Computing & Low-Latency Networks
edge_computing.description: V8 isolate edge workers, global CDN logic, and 5G mobile edge computing.

green_computing.name: Green Computing & Carbon-Aware Infrastructure
green_computing.description: Carbon-aware workload shifting, PUE optimization, and ARM cloud architectures.

product_manager.domain_objectives: Define cloud reliability targets (SLOs), infrastructure cost budgets (FinOps), and developer velocity metrics.
product_manager.requirements_rubric: High availability requirements (Multi-AZ / Multi-Region), disaster recovery RPO/RTO targets, and capacity scaling bounds.

system_architect.domain_objectives: Architect globally resilient, multi-region distributed topologies with self-healing failover and automated horizontal elasticity.

adversarial_sdet.threat_model: Pod eviction storms, network partitioning (split-brain), cloud provider zone outages, cascading connection timeouts.
chaos_vectors: Simulated packet loss and 500ms network latency injection
adversarial_sdet.boundary_fuzzing: Probe infrastructure with massive concurrent traffic spikes, resource starvation, and invalid ingress routing.

core_engineer.coding_idioms: Declarative YAML/HCL, idempotent execution scripts, automated health checks, modular reusable Terraform modules.
core_engineer.concurrency_rules: Distributed locking via etcd/Consul, graceful signal handling (SIGTERM), zero-downtime rolling updates.
core_engineer.memory_and_resource_rules: Explicit CPU/memory requests and limits on every container, cgroup bounds enforcement.

technical_writer.documentation_lexicon: SRE runbooks, architectural topology diagrams, disaster recovery procedures, and FinOps cost models.
technical_writer.architectural_diagram_style: Multi-region cloud topology diagrams, Kubernetes pod routing flows, and CI/CD GitOps pipelines.
